philosophy: Negative destructive behavior is the counterfeit expression of a God-given desire. Acknowledge the desire, find a constructive expression as replacement — no simple suppression. Each entry below names an underlying need and lists constructive expressions that satisfy the actual underlying desire (so it doesn't re-fire 20 minutes later in a different counterfeit form).

options.rationale: Real restoration. The urge for YouTube at 3pm is usually fatigue dressed as boredom; YouTube simulates restoration but doesn't deliver it.
Let the deep-work part of your brain recover by working on something less cognitively demanding.
Daylight + movement is restorative. Counts as rest.

novelty_hunger.what_it_wants: real intellectual stimulation, not the empty-calorie kind
diagnostic_signals: deep_work block + low fatigue + rising context_switches

options.rationale: Real novelty (curated) instead of cheap novelty. Returns you to the grindy sub-task with a fresh angle.
Different priority for one pomodoro. The brain wants a new problem, not a new feed.
Actual mental space, not the illusion of it.
5-minute voice message is real reciprocity. The hollow feeling after parasocial scroll is the absence of this.
Outdoors + voice + connection — three real needs satisfied at once.
Forward-momentum on a real plan with a real person.

frustration.what_it_wants: to drop the cognitive load — externalize the stuck problem
counterfeit_expressions: switch to a different easy distraction
diagnostic_signals: flat output 60-90+ min on a known-hard task

options.rationale: Walk + voice memo describing the bug as if to a junior. Externalizes the load. The bug-in-your-head IS the problem.
Post the stuck problem to a rubber-duck venue. Often the act of writing it solves it.
Background-process the hard problem while the foreground works on something else.
Pick the SINGLE next thing. Write it down. The fatigue is from holding all options open.
Pomodoro on the highest-weight priority. Closing the loop on one thing reduces fatigue more than rest.
Reduce visual choice surface; helps the next decision.

counterfeit_expressions: scroll for stimulation that's actually low blood sugar

options.rationale: Last meal: 4h+ ago. The screen-is-boring signal often means low blood sugar in disguise. Eat first, then decide; if the urge persists after eating, the diagnosis was wrong and we re-assess.

counterfeit_expressions: switch to a different screen (YouTube, phone)

options.rationale: Real screen-off, not screen-switch. Stretch + look at distance + close eyes.
Daylight + horizon focus.

counterfeit_expressions: guilt-eat the reward and miss it
skip the reward and brittle out

options.rationale: You earned it. Honor the ration. After the timer, re-diagnose the residual urge — usually post-reward fatigue, not real desire for more entertainment.
The residual urge is fatigue. Real restoration now lands you usefully tomorrow.
Hands-on activity that's restorative without being passive.
